title: Protein-domain track from Pfam/InterPro (CC0) for variant interpretation context
context: Protein domain annotations from Pfam/InterPro (CC0) mapped to genomic coordinates provide a useful research overlay showing whether a variant falls in a known functional domain (e.g. kinase domain, DNA-binding domain). This is a research-context layer, not clinical guidance. This backlog task overlaps with ds-pfam-008 from the source catalog; it is a distinct deliverable focused specifically on the variant-interpretation use case, as a standalone pack for the multi-source driver pack (pack-017) complement.
objective: Build a protein domain track from Pfam/InterPro (CC0) on hg38 mapped to gene coordinates, providing variant-interpretation context as a research overlay, with all three browser targets and per-feature provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is Pfam/InterPro (CC0); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true and nonCommercial: false.
Protein domain annotations are mapped to genomic coordinates on hg38; coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed.
All three browser targets emitted and render-verified; domain features appear at expected gene-coordinate loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/domains-026.json.
Per-feature provenance records Pfam/InterPro domain accessions, source release version, and CC0 license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
Pack carries not-medical-advice notice and is framed as a research-context overlay, not as individual variant interpretation; hosted at a loadable URL.
output: output/packs/pfam-domains-variant-context-hg38/ — BED/bigBed track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/domains-026.json.
